usage: “家中” (gaa1 zung1) can be used to refer to the inside of one's home or household. It emphasizes the location within the house.
It often functions as a noun to talk about activities that happen at home or the people living within the home.
You can use '家中' when describing where someone is or where something happens, usually contrasting with being outside.
It can also refer to matters concerning the family or household when used in context.
In casual speech, '家中' replaces more formal words like 'in the house' or 'at home'.
